column1: # Symbol dictionary: readings that name symbols. Embedded by symbol_dict.rs.
# reading <TAB> place <TAB> symbols separated by spaces
# place: first  - the reading names only a symbol (なかぐろ, やじるし): the
#                 symbols go before the model's candidates
#        after  - the reading is also an ordinary word (まる, かっこ): the
#                 symbols go after the model's top two and the kana forms
# きごう is deliberately absent: it must convert to 記号.
